newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT WAIKATO 26-16 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND BEAT WAIKATO 26-16 IN SUPER 12 MATCH.

text.p: Auckland beat Waikato 26-16 (halftime-11-6) in a Super 12 rugby union match at Albany on Saturday.
Auckland - Tries: Zinzan Brooke, Joeli Vidiri, penalty try. Penalties: Carlos Spencer (2). Conversion: Spencer. Dropped goal: Spencer.
Waikato - Try: Scott McLeod. Penalties: Bruce Reihana (2), Matthew Cooper. Conversions: Reihana.
